title: bev_fusion: camera + radar BEV system (base chain t8_ctl, variant t10_dual)
subtitle: Front camera + radar detections + ego motion -> timed map layers, object maps, boxes, lines. Learned between the cached camera features and the head outputs; red = a rule step on the path.

alt.label: alternative block (ModelConfig switch, not in the base chain)

nodes.label:
Front camera
now + 2 past frames
nodes.note: CAM_FRONT 1600 x 900 at 12 Hz, resized and cropped to 256 x 704 (cached features: the image is never read in training)

nodes.label:
Radar detections
all 5 radars, 0.5 s
nodes.note: position, range, Doppler, RCS, age per detection

nodes.label:
Ego motion
(v, omega, gap)
nodes.note: for the +-0.5 s outputs composed from the ground-truth poses of the target keyframe, in training AND in evaluation (evaluation/bev_adapter.py calls the same forward_loss); a deployed system has to supply odometry itself

nodes.label:
Frozen camera heads
DualBEV R50 + depth
nodes.note: pre-trained, run once offline and cached (float16: 118 depth probabilities + 80 context channels at stride 16); t10_dual adds the BEVFusion Swin-T side at stride 8
nodes.why: the whole image evidence enters as cached features; no config sets freeze_camera false, so no loss reaches the image network (only t3_adapter / t3_cam_adapter add a trainable block in front of the lift)
nodes.replace_with: train the image side: unfreeze (card t9 encoder 2 x 2, decision D26), a small adapter or LoRA on the frozen backbone, or distillation of a larger frozen teacher into a trainable student
nodes.catch: the cache no longer applies (images are read and encoded at train time, a multiple of the cost on one 12 GB GPU) and a trainable encoder can drift from the depth prior it came with

nodes.label:
Lift PD
depth-weighted gather
nodes.note: two grid_sample gathers per frame through a calibration table (voxel -> pixel + depth bin), feature x p(depth); the table is a detached constant with a hard validity mask

nodes.label:
Height collapse
640 -> 64 channels
nodes.note: 1 x 1 conv + BN + ReLU (cam_reduce; t10_dual: a second one and cam_merge)

nodes.label:
Camera temporal fusion
window + world memory
nodes.note: 2 past frames splatted to now with the ego motion and a learned velocity field, plus a world-aligned memory read by grid_sample

nodes.label:
Memory re-centre
round + roll
nodes.note: moves the memory window by whole cells when the ego drifts
nodes.why: integer shift of the stored state (round, int, roll, zero strip): no gradient in the pose; the learned parts read the memory through grid_sample, so training still reaches them
nodes.replace_with: a fixed world grid larger than the view (ring buffer, nothing shifted) or a sub-cell bilinear shift of the state
nodes.catch: memory size and cost; the effect on quality is small (a storage detail), listed because it is on the path

nodes.label:
Sweeps to now
ego pose + Doppler
nodes.note: all sweeps of the last 0.5 s moved to the camera time with exact poses, Doppler shifted along the ray; runs in the data loader and is cached
nodes.why: classical geometry on numpy points before the network (devkit point-cloud reader, rigid transform, Doppler shift); outside the gradient path
nodes.replace_with: feed the raw sweeps with their relative poses and ages as a set and let a point encoder (PointNet / transformer over points) absorb the motion compensation
nodes.catch: exact rigid motion is cheap to compute and easy to get wrong when learned; keep it as a fixed transform unless the odometry itself is learned

nodes.label:
Hard raster
floor + mean per cell
nodes.note: 14 channels per cell: count, mean of range, bearing, six Doppler harmonics, RCS, age, sub-cell offset
nodes.why: each detection goes into the one cell it falls in (floor, index_add_, mean); nothing trainable sits upstream, so no gradient is lost, but all detail inside a cell is averaged away before any weight sees it
nodes.replace_with: a learned point encoder (PointPillars-style PFN + scatter, already in the repo as RadarPillars, radar_kind pillars, arm t2_radar_pillars), a bilinear soft splat of point features, or cross-attention from BEV cells to the nearest detections
nodes.catch: scatter still needs a cell index; attention costs time per frame (latency budget); the pillars arm has been tried once and is not the base

nodes.label:
Radar convs
14 -> 32 channels
nodes.note: two 3 x 3 convs after the raster

nodes.label:
Concat fusion
modality dropout 0.2
nodes.note: camera (64) + radar (32) -> 3 x 3 conv -> 80 channels; one of the two sensors is blanked per sample in training

nodes.label:
BEV trunk
ResNet + FPN + detail
nodes.note: 3-stage ResNet + FPN_LSS + stride-1 detail path, initialised from DualBEV and trained; head reduction to 96 channels follows

nodes.label:
TimeMover
velocity + ego splat
nodes.note: moves the feature state to dt = -0.5 / 0 / +0.5 s: learned velocity field (zero start) + exact ego warp, bilinear softmax splat with a mass channel

nodes.label:
Semantic head
per dt
nodes.note: FiLM(dt) refine block + conv head: 5 areas, 2 line masks, 2 line distance fields, 3 object footprints

nodes.label:
Object head
CenterPoint, per dt
nodes.note: heatmap, sub-cell offset, size, rotation, radius, velocity (vx, vy), direction logit: conv branches

nodes.label:
Map layers
12 channels per dt
nodes.note: logits from the semantic head: network layers only

nodes.label:
Object maps
hm off size rot vel dir
nodes.note: dense, network layers only; the box velocity is the vel branch read at a peak

nodes.label:
Line extraction
zero crossing
nodes.note: consumer side
nodes.why: cells that are a local minimum of the line distance field along x or y and below half a cell; lines stay pixel and field based, not vectors
nodes.replace_with: deliver the distance field itself (differentiable, a planner can read its gradient) or a learned vectorisation (point-set queries per polyline, MapTR-style)
nodes.catch: a vector head is a new head with its own matching-free loss; the field is the cheaper, already trained deliverable

nodes.label: Line cells
nodes.note: scored in the evaluation as map lines

nodes.label:
Box decode
peak, top-k, threshold
nodes.note: consumer side; evaluation k = 100 and score 0.05, model.boxes k = 50 and 0.2
nodes.why: 3 x 3 max-pool equality keeps local maxima, top-k and a score threshold pick the detections, then exp(size), atan2(rot), a yaw fold by the direction logit and the velocity read at the chosen cell; no IoU NMS anywhere; dense losses train the maps, so this selection costs no gradient in training
nodes.replace_with: keep the dense maps as the deliverable for a downstream network; or a learned selection: soft top-k (optimal transport), a learned NMS (relation network), or set prediction with queries (DETR3D family, trained with Sinkhorn / Hungarian matching)
nodes.catch: the matching-based set losses are a rule step of their own during training; a downstream consumer of dense maps needs a planner interface for them

nodes.label:
Boxes
pose, size, yaw, velocity
nodes.note: boxes of the three groups vehicle, two_wheeler, pedestrian (circle)

nodes.label:
Ground truth
(autogt)
nodes.note: layers, boxes, radar-corrected velocity, masks at -0.5 / 0 / +0.5 s; signature = sha1 of the generator files

nodes.label:
Losses
BEVLoss + Kendall
nodes.note: areas, lines, objects, motion in four groups with learned weights; the gradient reaches every module from the camera reduce onward

nodes.label: Data and caches
nodes.note: camera feature cache, radar cache, GT cache, mirror augmentation

nodes.label:
Trainer
EMA, resume, stop
nodes.note: AdamW + cosine, gradient accumulation, EMA 0.999, checkpoint before evaluation, resume, CONTROL / STOPPED

nodes.label:
Alternatives
in ModelConfig
nodes.note: RadarPillars, second trunk, CMX / gate fusion, GRU temporal, LiftS, the t7 lane branch: control arms and add-ons

groups.label: consumer side: outside the model's forward

not_drawn.training/temporal.py: older multi-hypothesis temporal propagation, superseded by temporal_fusion.py; imported only by tests and scratch
not_drawn.training/radar_encoder.py: delta-coded slot raster of plan 3.4, not imported by model.py or train.py
not_drawn.training/legacy: S1 single-sensor pipeline and the t4 DualBEV front; nothing in model / train / evaluation imports it
